pages.text: My name is Anita. I am 8 years old.
I love playing with my friends at school.
John is my brother. He is older than me.
Our neighbours are good to us.
John, Peter and I go to the same school.
My mother and I go to the market every Saturday.
My brother and I draw funny pictures.
My brother John is a good reader. He reads for others in his class.
My father is a librarian in our school. He chooses storybooks for children.
When school closes, we go to visit our grandparents in the village.
I love my family, grandparents and neighbours very much.

credits.changes: Pictures resized and converted to WebP. Extra spaces removed.
